claims.claim: Tyson is a world‑class food company with a broad portfolio of iconic brands and about 124,000 team members worldwide
claims.quote: Tyson Foods, Inc. and its subsidiaries (collectively, the “Company,” “we,” “us,” “our,” “Tyson”) ... had approximately 124,000 employees (“team members”) on October 3, 2026.

claims.claim: The company operates a fully vertically integrated chicken production process that spans breeding, feed, hatchery, grow‑out, processing and distribution
claims.quote: We operate a fully vertically integrated chicken production process.

claims.claim: Tyson also processes live cattle and hogs into dressed meat, case‑ready products and specialty items
claims.quote: We also process live fed cattle and hogs and fabricate dressed beef and pork carcasses into primal and sub‑primal meat cuts, case‑ready beef and pork and fully cooked meats.

claims.claim: A dedicated venture subsidiary invests in innovative protein, animal‑welfare and sustainability technologies
claims.quote: Tyson New Ventures, LLC is used to broaden our exposure to innovative forms of protein and opportunities to improve animal welfare, water management, packaging and land stewardship...

claims.claim: Tyson competes globally with other food producers and seeks market leadership through advertising, price, product safety, brand strength and innovation
claims.quote: Our food products compete with those of other food producers and processors and certain prepared food manufacturers.

claims.claim: The principal competitive elements include advertising, consumer and trade promotions, price, product safety and quality, brand identification, innovation, breadth and depth of product offerings, availability of products, customer service and credit terms
claims.quote: The principal competitive elements are advertising, consumer and trade promotions, price, product safety and quality, brand identification, innovation, breadth and depth of product offerings, availability of products, customer service and credit terms.

claims.claim: Walmart represents the largest single customer, contributing roughly nineteen percent of consolidated sales; no other customer exceeds ten percent
claims.quote: Walmart Inc. accounted for approximately 19.0% of our fiscal 2026 consolidated sales. ... No other single customer or customer group represented more than 10% of fiscal 2026 consolidated sales.

claims.claim: Tyson markets products in roughly one hundred forty countries and regions, with major sales markets across North America, Europe, Asia and the Middle East
claims.quote: We sold products in approximately 140 countries and regions in fiscal 2026.

claims.claim: Management expects domestic protein production to be flat to slightly higher in fiscal 2027, providing a neutral to modestly positive supply backdrop
claims.quote: For fiscal 2027, the United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) indicates domestic protein production (beef, pork, chicken and turkey) will be flat to a slight increase compared to fiscal 2026 levels.

claims.claim: Liquidity is projected to stay well above the company’s minimum target, supporting operations and strategic initiatives
claims.quote: We expect total liquidity, which was $4.1 billion as of October 3, 2026, to remain well above our minimum liquidity target of $1.0 billion.

claims.claim: Tyson conducts continuous research and development, including new product innovation, ingredient simplification, automation and breeding stock improvements
claims.quote: We conduct continuous research and development activities which include new product innovation, product improvements, ingredient simplification, manual process automation in our processing facilities and grow‑out operations and chicken breeding stock improvements.

claims.claim: The company’s network optimization plan is a key catalyst, but its success depends on efficient implementation and may incur multi‑year costs
claims.quote: The success of our network optimization plan, or any other financial or operational optimization plans, will depend in part on our ability to successfully implement them in an efficient and effective manner.

claims.claim: Disease outbreaks such as African swine fever or highly pathogenic avian influenza could materially affect livestock supply, product demand and brand perception
claims.quote: Supply of and demand for our products can be adversely impacted by disease outbreaks impacting animals, animal products and livestock, such as African swine fever (“ASF”), bovine spongiform encephalopathy, foot and mouth disease, highly pathogenic avian influenza (“HPAI”)...

claims.claim: Fluctuations in commodity and feed‑grain prices can erode gross margins and limit the ability to pass costs to customers
claims.quote: Fluctuations in commodity prices and in the availability of raw materials, especially feed grains, live cattle, live swine and other inputs, could negatively impact our earnings.

claims.claim: Intensifying competition and private‑label pressure may force price concessions or higher promotional spending, weighing on profitability
claims.quote: The food industry in general is intensely competitive. We face competition from other food producers and processors ... From time to time, in response to competitive pressures or to maintain market share, we may need to reduce the prices for some of our products...

claims.claim: Climate‑change risks could raise input costs, disrupt production and require additional capital expenditures
claims.quote: Climate change may have a long‑term adverse impact on our business.

claims.claim: Judgment: Maintain and expand R&D investment to sustain product innovation and mitigate competitive pressure
claims.quote: We conduct continuous research and development activities which include new product innovation, product improvements, ingredient simplification, manual process automation in our processing facilities and grow‑out operations and chicken breeding stock improvements.

claims.claim: Judgment: Prioritize execution of the network optimization plan while monitoring cost overruns, as management warns that implementation may be more difficult, costly or time‑consuming than expected
claims.quote: The success of our network optimization plan, or any other financial or operational optimization plans, will depend in part on our ability to successfully implement them in an efficient and effective manner.

gaps: No specific quantitative guidance for segment volume growth or price trends beyond the general USDA outlook and liquidity statement.
The filing does not provide detailed timelines or capital allocation amounts for upcoming innovation projects beyond the broad R&D description.
There is no disclosed metric on the expected impact of AI or emerging technologies on operating efficiency; only risk statements are provided.
insight: Insight: Tyson’s fully vertically integrated chicken model gives it control over breeding, feed, processing and distribution, a capability highlighted by its claim "We operate a fully vertically integrated chicken production process" — 10-K line 132.
